svg.text: Arduino Uno + HC-SR04 + hobby servo · the arm angle tracks the measured distance · same pins as servo-follow.ino
Rewritten in 2026 · not tested with a servo — on the bench the same proximity loop drove a propeller motor in place of the servo.
Hobby servo — arm angle follows the distance
Build it in this order — numbers match the white circles on the wires
Closed loop: distance 5 cm → arm at 0°, 50 cm → 180°. Each reading is filtered (median of 3 + moving average + 2° dead band + 4° step limit) so the arm does not jitter.
An SG90 micro servo can run from the Uno 5 V pin. Bigger servos (MG996R…) need their own 5-6 V supply: feed it into the top rails, leave out wire 3 and keep wire 4 (shared GND).
Servo lead colours vary: brown/black = GND, red = +5 V, orange/yellow/white = signal. If the red/blue rail lines have a gap in the middle, bridge each rail with a short jumper.
